dict.string: PIXMYD uses the camera to photograph the site you are scanning. Images stay on this device unless you export them.
PIXMYD records a position for each capture so the result can be placed in project coordinates. Without it a scan has no georeference.
PIXMYD reads the motion sensors to track where the camera is between frames. Scanning does not work without them.
PIXMYD connects to an external RTK GNSS receiver over Bluetooth for centimetre-accurate positions.
PIXMYD saves exported models and point clouds to your photo library when you ask it to.
PIXMYD reaches an NTRIP caster on your network to fetch RTK corrections.
